step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram shows two parallel pipelines receiving chat conversation data via Kinesis from three input channels (Mobile, Web, Messaging platforms):
1. Real-time processing pipeline (bottom path): Kinesis -> Logstash -> Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) -> Custom Dashboard.
2. Archival/Historical processing pipeline (top path): Kinesis -> Lambda -> S3, with Glue analyzing S3 schemas for querying via Athena.
Services and external components are accurately identified from the visual diagram and audio context, mapped directly to exact standard schema labels. Strictly formatted as valid JSON without control characters.
